title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། ཝེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 189)
shelf_note: Canonical Derge Tengyur Pramāṇa (epistemology/logic) commentary addressing Buddhist theories of perception, determination, and exclusion (apoha).

tr_errors_A.english: Thus says the proponent of the philosophical tenet regarding non-observation…
tr_errors_A.problem: Misinterprets the objection marker (zhe na) and the following agent (grub pa'i mtha' smra bas) as a concluding attribution of the opponent's objection rather than introducing the Siddhāntin's rebuttal continuing onto the next leaf.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B accurately preserves the dialectical structure (distinguishing the opponent's objection from the Siddhāntin's reply) and uses more precise philosophical terminology.

book_verdict: A well-preserved woodblock folio from the Derge Tengyur Pramāṇa section with completely accurate OCR and an excellent translation B.
